class.name: TrackRouteSegment
class.brief_description: One track of a traced route.
class.description: What [method TrackServer.track_trace_route] and [method RailVehicleServer.vehicle_trace_route] answer with, track by track.

members.member: The switch's branch the route takes.
The branch is the switch's setting (entered at its common end), not the one entered on: throwing the switch changes the route from here.
From the vehicle to where the track is entered [m], negative for the one it stands on.
The track is driven towards its end (event2), not its start (event1).
The track is a switch, passed as it is set.
The track's speed limit [km/h], -1 for none.
